context: A PTA committee meeting. Asuka chairs; Hiroshi the boss attends as a grandparent representative.
purpose: formal community meeting — adult professionals coordinating respectfully

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 本日はお集まりいただき、ありがとうございます。
lines.style: Teacher warm formal professional chair-opener, the soft real careful-respect audible, gentle real composure threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お招きいただき、こちらこそ。
lines.en: Thank you for the invitation, on my side.
lines.style: Boss warm measured formal civil-respectful, the soft real authority-soft audible, gentle real composure threading throughout delivery throughout.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 今回は、運動会の準備について、ご意見をいただきたく。
lines.en: Today, we'd like your opinions on sports day prep.
lines.style: Teacher warm formal professional clear-directing, the soft real careful-respect audible, gentle real composure threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: なるほど。報告書、拝見しました。
lines.en: I see. I've looked over the report.
lines.style: Boss warm measured formal acknowledging, the soft real careful-prepared audible, gentle real composure threading throughout delivery throughout.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 何か気になる点、ございますか。
lines.en: Are there any points of concern?
lines.style: Teacher warm formal professional opening dialogue, the soft real careful-respect audible, gentle real composure threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 一つご提案、よろしいでしょうか。
lines.style: Boss warm formal courteous careful requesting, the soft real careful-respect audible, gentle real composure threading throughout delivery throughout.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: はい、ぜひお聞かせください。
lines.style: Teacher warm formal professional inviting, the soft real respectful-attention audible, gentle real composure threading throughout delivery throughout.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お年寄りが参加できる種目を、ぜひ。
lines.en: Events the elderly can join — please, by all means.
lines.style: Boss warm measured formal heartfelt suggestion, the soft real real-care audible, gentle real composure threading throughout delivery throughout.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 素晴らしいご提案。検討させていただきます。
lines.en: A splendid proposal. We'll consider it.
lines.style: Teacher warm formal warm appreciative committed, the soft real real-pleased audible, gentle real composure threading throughout delivery.
